_schema_info.name: PMEGP Document Metadata Schema
_schema_info.description: Production-frozen metadata schema for every document in the PMEGP archive. This JSON Schema mirrors the canonical spec in docs/metadata_schema.md and is enforced by scripts/validate/validate_metadata.py. Every PDF committed to the repository MUST have a corresponding entry in metadata/documents.json that conforms to this schema.
changelog: v2.0.0 (2026-08-08): Re-aligned with production schema. Replaced legacy PMEGP-AP-YYYY-NNN ID pattern, category/sub_category enums, language/pages/file_format/ocr_status fields, and verification_status with the production field set (document_id, type, issuing_authority, department, state, district, date, reference_no, subject, keywords, source_url, status, source_authority_level, quality_authenticity, quality_document, quality_metadata, file_path, provenance, relationships). Added independent multi-dimensional quality scoring (A/B/C) and acquisition-state aware provenance block.
v1.0.0 (2026-08-07): Initial legacy schema with category folders 01-07 and PMEGP-AP-YYYY-NNN IDs. Superseded.

document_id.description: Unique primary key across the archive. Format: [TERRITORY]-[AGENCY_CODE]-[YEAR]-[SEQUENCE]. Examples: 'IN-MSME-2018-0001' (Central MSME), 'AP-COI-2024-0012' (AP Commissioner of Industries), 'AP_ANA-DIC-2024-0002' (Anakapalli DIC). See docs/document_classification.md for the full Territory / Agency code list.

title.description: Full official title of the document as it appears on the cover page. Preserve original capitalization and do not abbreviate.

type.description: Document type. Must be one of the controlled vocabulary values enforced by the validator.

issuing_authority.description: Full name of the issuing agency. Examples: 'Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises', 'Commissioner of Industries', 'State Level Bankers\' Committee'.

state.description: Jurisdictional level. 'Central' for national-level documents and 'Andhra Pradesh' for state-level documents. Per AD-0001 in docs/ACQUISITION_DECISIONS.md, no other states are within scope.

district.description: Official district name if district-specific (e.g. 'Anakapalli'), otherwise null for state/national-level documents. The slug form must match one of the 26 AP districts listed in docs/document_classification.md or the validator will reject the entry.

date.description: Official date the document was issued, in YYYY-MM-DD format. If only month/year is known, use YYYY-MM-01 and add a note in provenance.notes.

reference_no.description: Official reference / file number as printed on the document. Examples: 'Rc.No. 12/PMEGP/2024', 'No. 01/2023-PMEGP'.

subject.description: One-sentence summary of the document's content. Used as the primary display text in search results.

keywords.description: Searchable keyword tags. Always include 'PMEGP' as the first keyword. Use Title Case for multi-word tags. Example: ['PMEGP', 'Subsidy', 'EDP Training', 'Bank Accounts'].

source_url.description: Direct URL to the original download location. Use null only if the document was collected via RTI / physical archive and has no digital source. Per AD-0002, secondary official mirrors (e.g. SLBC Odisha) are acceptable when the primary portal is offline.

status.description: Legal / administrative status of the document. 'Active' = currently in force, 'Superseded' = replaced by a newer document (link via relationships.superseded_by), 'Withdrawn' = revoked without replacement, 'Cancelled' = voided, 'Merged' = combined into a new policy, 'Amended' = modified by a subsequent order (link via relationships.amended_by).

source_authority_level.description: Reliability tier of the sourcing channel. PRIMARY = direct from issuing authority portal, SECONDARY = official government/bank mirror, MIRROR = third-party public mirror, ARCHIVED = physical / RTI / scanned offline record.

quality_authenticity.description: Document authenticity grade. A = cryptographically signed, officially stamped, or gazette-published; B = unsigned but complete official publication on a primary/certified portal; C = copy with minor missing seal/signature context but textually authentic.

quality_document.description: Document format / legibility grade. A = digital-native PDF with fully selectable text; B = high-quality OCR or clean scan; C = low-quality scan, partially blurred/skewed but textually complete.

quality_metadata.description: Metadata completeness grade. A = all fields populated, deep keywords, active relationships; B = essential fields complete with standard keywords and verified provenance; C = basic fields populated, missing non-essential relationship/provenance links.

file_path.description: Relative path to the PDF inside this repository, using forward slashes. Must match the directory mapping in docs/document_classification.md. Example: 'central-government/msme/guidelines/IN-MSME-2018-0001.pdf'. The validator will fail if the file does not exist at this path.

provenance.description: Tamper-evident provenance block. The SHA-256 hash acts as both an integrity seal and a duplicate detector (the validator rejects two entries with identical hashes).

downloaded_from.description: Exact live URL the file was fetched from. Null only for offline / RTI collections.

download_date.description: Date the file was downloaded, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

downloaded_by.description: GitHub username or identity of the collector. Used for audit attribution.

sha256.description: SHA-256 cryptographic hash of the PDF file (lowercase hex, 64 chars). Computed by scripts/metadata/generate_metadata.py at ingestion time.

original_filename.description: Filename as originally served by the source portal, before being renamed to match the document_id convention.

archive_url.description: Permanent web archive URL (e.g. Wayback Machine snapshot) if available. Null if not archived.

relationships.description: Direct policy relationships to other documents in the archive. Use to model supersession, amendments, and citation links. Empty array if no relationships exist.

target_id.description: document_id of the related document. Must already exist in the archive.

type.description: Relationship type. 'supersedes' = this document replaces the target; 'superseded_by' = this document is replaced by the target; 'amends' / 'amended_by' = modification link; 'references' / 'referenced_by' = citation link.
